brief_rationale: The doctor demonstrated excellent clinical reasoning and responsibility-chain execution, properly investigating the calcaneal injury concern, managing medication safety, providing clear red flags, and using workspace verification. No responsibility-chain errors identified. The trajectory included meaningful dynamic reprioritization (HO3 complete) when the patient proceeded to emergency evaluation, and safe bounded closure with teach-back (HO4 complete). All five dimensions rated good or excellent. Grade 4 Strong.
